profiles.name: Kuo-toa
speciesTraits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid (Aquatic). +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +4 Wisdom, −2 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +6 natural armor.
Amphibious (Ex) allows indefinite breathing in air and water. Swim speed 50 ft. gives +8 on Swim checks for hazards and special actions and allows taking 10 even under pressure.
Keen Sight (Ex) can spot moving creatures or objects even if invisible or ethereal. An invisible or ethereal target that keeps still can avoid this detection.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Electricity resistance 10. Immune to poison and paralysis. Slippery (Ex) provides immunity to magical and ordinary webs. Racial bonuses are +8 on Escape Artist and +4 on Search and Spot.

Adhesive (Ex). Coating a shield takes 1 hour and materials worth 20 gp. A missed melee attack against the kuo-toa triggers Reflex DC 11 + its Constitution modifier. On a failed save a held weapon sticks and is pulled from its wielder’s grip, or a natural-weapon attacker is grappled. The coating expires after three days or one catch. A DC 20 Strength check frees the weapon or limb.

Lightning Bolt (Su). Two or more kuo-toa clerics (whips) stay within 30 ft. of one another to build a bolt every 1d4 rounds and join hands to release it. It deals 1d6 damage per whip. Reflex halves at DC 11 + highest participating Wisdom modifier + number of whips.
Weapon Familiarity treats pincer staffs as martial weapons.

Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, Will +3, and one feat. Racial skill points are 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Craft, Escape Artist, Knowledge, Listen, Move Silently, Search, and Spot.
LA +3. ECL 5 with only racial Hit Dice. ECL 6 with one class level. Favored class Rogue.

Racial automatic languages are Kuo-Toan, Undercommon, and Aquan. Racial bonus languages are Common, Dwarven, Elven, and Serusan, or use the regional bonus list. The Kuo-Toa region lists Common, Kuo-Toan, and Undercommon as automatic and Aquan, Draconic, Dwarven, and Elven (drow dialect) as bonus languages.

npcBuilds.name: Lilli Seachild

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).
build.title: Kuo-toa shore warden, Fighter 1
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +1, natural armor +6. Touch 11, flat-footed 20. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +5.
Amphibious (Ex) allows indefinite breathing in air and water. Swim speed 50 ft. gives +8 on Swim checks for hazards and special actions and allows taking 10 even under pressure.
Keen Sight (Ex) can spot moving creatures or objects even if invisible or ethereal. An invisible or ethereal target that keeps still can avoid this detection.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Electricity resistance 10. Immune to poison and paralysis. Slippery (Ex) provides immunity to magical and ordinary webs. Racial bonuses are +8 on Escape Artist and +4 on Search and Spot.
Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Focus (shortspear) adds +1 to attacks with the shortspear.
actions: Adhesive (Ex). Coating a shield takes 1 hour and materials worth 20 gp. A missed melee attack against the kuo-toa triggers Reflex DC 11 + its Constitution modifier. On a failed save a held weapon sticks and is pulled from its wielder’s grip, or a natural-weapon attacker is grappled. The coating expires after three days or one catch. A DC 20 Strength check frees the weapon or limb.
The shield starts with a fresh coating. The save to avoid it is Reflex DC 14. Once it catches a weapon or limb, mark the coating spent.
After one round of blindness from abrupt bright light, sustained bright light reduces the shortspear attack to +6, Search to +9, and saves to Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +4.
build.tactics: Lilli keeps her coated shield between herself and an attacker on the landing. If daylight floods the shore, she withdraws into the deeper passage when she can do so safely.

npcBuilds.motive: Keep the landing open for the boat coming out of the lower passage.
npcBuilds.hook: Lilli has just recoated her shield and is holding the landing alone.

npcBuilds.name: Rripp Siltwatch

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +3).
build.title: Kuo-toa sluice scout, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, natural armor +6. Touch 13, flat-footed 18. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +8, Will +6.
Amphibious (Ex) allows indefinite breathing in air and water. Swim speed 50 ft. gives +8 on Swim checks for hazards and special actions and allows taking 10 even under pressure.
Keen Sight (Ex) can spot moving creatures or objects even if invisible or ethereal. An invisible or ethereal target that keeps still can avoid this detection.
Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or a daylight spell, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Electricity resistance 10. Immune to poison and paralysis. Slippery (Ex) provides immunity to magical and ordinary webs. Racial bonuses are +8 on Escape Artist and +4 on Search and Spot.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity to attack with the rapier. Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 on eligible hits.
actions: Use Swim +12 to take 10 for a result of 22 when crossing a hazardous sluice. Use Escape Artist +16 if caught in a mundane snare. Webs do not impede this scout.

A moving invisible swimmer can be seen through Keen Sight if the scout can otherwise see the swimmer’s location. A perfectly still opponent can evade the ability. Seeing an ethereal target does not allow a mundane rapier to strike it.
build.tactics: Rripp waits below the sluice, watching for movement in the dim channel. He signals the party when the moving scout crosses his view, then swims around the obstruction.

npcBuilds.motive: Find the moving intruder before it reaches the upper gate.
npcBuilds.hook: Rripp gives the party a signal when the unseen swimmer passes the sluice.
